intentions.title: Make crashed control-plane workers self-heal instead of wedging customer resources forever
intentions.evidence: stale_deployment_reaper.ex sweeps deploy claims left in 'building'/'pushing' by a crashed builder or on-box agent; stale_provision_job_reaper.ex does the same for provision jobs stuck in 'claimed' after a crashed worker. Both explicitly frame the alternative as 'stuck behind an eternal spinner permanently' / 'provisioning forever' and both run every minute via the same unique-window Oban pattern (period:60, states spanning available/scheduled/executing/retryable/suspended) so a slow sweep never stacks with the next tick.

intentions.title: Ship autonomous, health-gated fleet self-update rollout with zero human trigger step
intentions.evidence: autoupdate_rollout_worker.ex (isu-w4) advances one instance at a time (serial cohort-of-1 canary), settles in-flight instances against their own live verdict, pauses (never retries) an instance that fails to settle within 20 minutes or reports 503 (no one-click apply armed), and treats a blessed release from release-curator as the sole trigger — 'no human step, opt-out per instance'.

intentions.title: Give every instance an honest, continuously-refreshed self-update status without the fleet dashboard ever blocking on it
intentions.evidence: update_status_worker.ex (isu-6) treats each instance as source of truth for its own update state via GET /v1/admin/self-update, sweeps hourly plus on-demand per-instance refresh after a manual trigger, always lands 'unknown' rather than raising, and isolates one bad instance from sinking the whole sweep.

intentions.title: Let the fleet Overview render usage instantly by pre-computing a cached sample per instance instead of live fan-out
intentions.evidence: usage_sampler_worker.ex (cloud-console wave 3) writes one Usage.Sample row per checkable instance every ~15 minutes so GET /v1/usage/summary answers with zero instance HTTP; explicitly degrades a down box to 'unmetered' (never a fake zero) while still stamping a real measured_at, and per-instance isolation stops one pathological gather from sinking the sweep.

intentions.title: Enforce trial billing as a strictly one-way, spam-free, never-teardown-a-paying-customer lifecycle
intentions.evidence: trial_expiry_worker.ex (dwb-13) sends T-3/T-1 notices via atomic UPDATE...WHERE stamp IS NULL claims (exactly-once), and tears down only teams still in Billing.active_trials/0 — the moduledoc calls out 'MONEY-PATH SAFETY (adversarial)': a converted team's row is a paid plan so it can never be torn down, and conversion additionally cancels any in-flight deprovision job to close the convert-just-after-expiry race.

intentions.title: Bound every unbounded append-only cloud-plane table with age-based retention so operational history never grows forever
intentions.evidence: agent_retention_worker.ex (charter D48) runs daily to prune agent_events (14d), dead agent_tokens (30d grace past revoked_at/expires_at, live tokens never touched), and usage_samples (14d) — explicitly the housekeeping counterpart to per-minute staleness reapers; device_auth_reaper.ex does the same per-minute for expired device-authorization rows, framed as pure hygiene since expiry is already enforced in-band by query filters.

intentions.title: Move outbound chat notification delivery off the request path with retry semantics that distinguish terminal failures from transient ones
intentions.evidence: chat_notification_worker.ex is the Oban replacement for a swarm-candidate's Task.Supervisor + inline Process.sleep retry loop: 4xx/bad-creds/SSRF/gone map to {:cancel, reason} (terminal, no retry) while 5xx/transport errors get Oban-driven [1s,5s,30s] backoff; credentials are decrypted in-process per delivery and never carried in job args.
